posts.author: Toga
posts.body:
Hi,
Apologies if this is not the correct place for this - I am new to the Forum and MZ, I worked on MV a while ago but never actually finished my project so I'm starting again with MZ.
Anyway my question is, is it possible to have an inventory screen that is always visible on the screen, maybe on the right hand side it takes up a portion of the full screen for example like this? With or without the HP / Mana bar as that's not really needed as much
Thanks for your help in advance!

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
Are you looking for a visual inventory or something like in your pic that visually shows your equipment? If the latter, then I don't know of such a plugin, but you can try eventing and other plugins. Just show those background slots as picture, then get a plugin that runs a common event when you close menu. In that common event you use a plugin to show icons as pictures depending on your equipment (I think you can get the correct icon id with like
$dataWeapons[WeaponId].iconIndex
etc. Also run the common event if some event changes your equipment.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Welcome!
It's always a good idea to try searching for things you want - I Googled "rpg maker mz inventory plugin" and got this:
Map Inventory MZ + MV (visual grid inventory) [Update 2.0]
Map Inventory by Pheonix KageDesu        Visual Map Inventory (grid inventory)    ☝ WARNING: Plugin is designed for work with Mouse!  This plugin is separated part from Alpha ABS plugin.  Last Version: 2.0 (19.09.2021)   ✅Features:   25 items on page, support multi pages Items separated on...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
That has the inventory grid, you can equip gear from the window, and you can leave it open. It does not have the specific spaces with pictures for the different equip slots like your sample picture.
If that part of it is important, you may need to get into something custom-made or modified. You probably won't see it as a regular public plugin because it would rely on your project having specific equip slots.
